subject: Inside the Deku Tree
text: The main body of Inside the Deku Tree is the interior of the Great Deku Tree's trunk, featuring four main levels: The Top Floor, The Main Floor, The Basement, and the Sub-Basement.

evidence.quote: The main body of the dungeon is the interior of the Great Deku Tree's trunk, and all of the other rooms in the dungeon stretch out from this central area.  The Trunk has four main levels: The Top Floor, The Main Floor, The Basement, and the Sub-Basement.

subject: Deku Babas
text: Deku Babas in the corners of the room drop Deku Sticks and/or Deku Nuts when defeated.

evidence.quote: Start by killing the Deku Babas in the corners of the room.  Hold your shield up with R while Z-Targeting to absorb their attacks.  Take the Deku Sticks and/or Deku Nuts that they drop.

subject: chest
text: A chest along the upper ledge of the Trunk contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Open the chest part of the way along the ledge to find the Dungeon Map.

subject: The Trunk
text: Continuing right along the ledge past the Dungeon Map chest leads to a door into the next room.

evidence.quote: Keep going right along the ledge and enter the door you come to.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: Defeat the Deku Scrub by reflecting the Deku Nut he fires back into his face and standing on his nest when he runs.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Deku Scrub by Z-Targeting him and reflecting the Deku Nut he fires back into his face.  The Scrub will then get up and start running around the room.  Don't chase him; go and stand on his nest.  When the Scrub attempts to return to his nest, he will walk right into you.

subject: fall damage
text: Pressing forward on the joystick as you land helps avoid fall damage.

evidence.quote: He will then open both of the doors in the room, and give you a useful hint for avoiding fall damage (press forward on the joystick as you land).

subject: Scrub Room #1
text: Going northeast through the door in Scrub Room #1 leads to the Slingshot Room.

evidence.quote: Go northeast through the door to the next room.

subject: chest
text: A chest on the far ledge past the falling gray platform in the Slingshot Room contains the Fairy Slingshot and Bullet Bag x30.

evidence.quote: Jump out to the gray platform, but quickly jump to the next ledge, as the platform will quickly begin to fall.  Open the chest to find the Fairy Slingshot (and the Bullet Bag x30 which goes with it, though it isn't mentioned in-game).

subject: chest
text: Climbing the ivy wall to the right in the Slingshot Room leads to a chest containing a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Turn to the right and climb the ivy wall.  Open the chest for a Recovery Heart.

subject: ladder
text: Shooting down the ladder hanging above the entrance door with the Fairy Slingshot allows you to climb up and exit back to Scrub Room #1.

evidence.quote: Using the Fairy Slingshot, shoot down the ladder that hangs above the door.  Jump down and climb up the ladder, then go back through the door.

subject: The Trunk
text: Shooting down three Skullwalltullas on the ivy wall with the Slingshot allows climbing to the highest level of the Deku Tree, where continuing left leads to a door.

evidence.quote: Use the Slingshot to shoot down the three Skullwalltullas clinging to the ivy wall.  Once they are out of the way, climb the wall to the top, and then to the left to reach the highest level of the Deku Tree... keep going to the left until you reach a door.  Go through it.

subject: chest
text: Stepping on the switch next to the lantern raises three platforms that allow Link to reach a chest in the back of the room containing the Compass.

evidence.quote: Turn to the right and step on the switch next to the lantern.  The three platforms in the center of the room will begin to rise.  Quickly jump along them to the ledge in the back of the room.  Open the chest to find the Compass.

subject: chest
text: A chest in the small northern alcove past the Big Skulltula contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Step on the switch again, and this time use the platforms to reach the small alcove in the northern part of the room.  Jump past the Big Skulltula and open the chest for a Recovery Heart.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Killing the Gold Skulltula in the back of the northern alcove yields a Gold Skulltula Token.

evidence.quote: Kill the Gold Skulltula in the back of the alcove to get the game's first Gold Skulltula Token.

subject: door
text: Catching a Deku Stick on fire from the lantern and using it to light the burned-out lantern unlocks the door in the Compass Room.

evidence.quote: Use a Deku Stick near the lantern, and it will catch on fire.  Use the flaming Deku Stick to light the burned out lantern, and the door will unlock.  Go through the door.

subject: Big Skulltula
text: Defeat the Big Skulltula by Z-Targeting it, waiting for it to spin around, and hitting it with a Jump Attack.

evidence.quote: When you reach the second one, kill it by Z-Targeting it, and waiting for it to spin around.  Use a Jump Attack when it does this.

subject: The Trunk Top Floor
text: Jumping off the edge and landing directly on the bit of webbing on the first floor breaks through it into the sub-basement level of the Trunk.

evidence.quote: You're now going to have to jump off the edge and land on the bit of webbing, clear down on the first floor of the Trunk... If you land right on the webbing, you will break through it into the sub basement level of the Trunk.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula on the grating on the eastern side of the room drops a token when shot with the Fairy Slingshot.

evidence.quote: Use your Fairy Slingshot to kill the Gold Skulltula on the grating on the eastern side of the room.  Jump out from the ledge to reach it, then climb back up onto the ledge.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: A Gold Skulltula on the long ivy wall on the south side of the sub-basement drops a token when killed.

evidence.quote: Face the long ivy wall that you fell down to reach this area, on the south side of the room.  Kill the second Gold Skulltula, and climb up the wall to claim the token.

subject: chest
text: A chest behind the lantern on the southeast ledge contains a Recovery Heart.

evidence.quote: Climb back up onto the southeast ledge once more, and open the chest behind the lantern to find a Recovery Heart.

subject: web-covered door
text: Burning the webs on the wall with a flaming Deku Stick lit from the lantern reveals a door on the southwest ledge.

evidence.quote: Light a Deku Stick on the lantern, then quickly jump out onto the pond so that you land on the shallow bit which Link can stand on without having to swim.  From there, jump to the southwest ledge, run past the Deku Baba and use the flaming Deku Stick to burn the webs on the wall, revealing a door.  Go through this door.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: In Scrub Room #2, deflect the Scrub's Deku Nuts with the Deku Shield and stand on his nest when he runs to defeat him and hear the hint '23 is number 1'.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Scrub in this room by deflecting the Deku Nuts he fires back at him with your Deku Shield (the Slingshot doesn't work, he just retreats back into the ground).  Once he starts running around the room, run to his nest and stand on it.  When he tries to return to his nest, he'll run right into you, thus defeating him.  He'll mention that "23 is number 1," which is actually a hint to solve the last puzzle before the boss.

subject: west door
text: Shooting the Silver Eye above the west door with the Fairy Slingshot unlocks the door.

evidence.quote: Shoot the Silver Eye above the west door with the Fairy Slingshot to unlock the door.  Go through the door to the next room.

subject: underwater button
text: Swimming down and holding A to touch the button on the left side of the pool directly beneath the rotating spikes lowers the water level considerably.

evidence.quote: On the left side of the pool, against the wall, directly beneath the rotating spikes, there is a button.  Swim over this button, then press and hold down A to swim down and touch the switch... Once the switch is activated, the water level in the pool will lower considerably.

subject: floating platform
text: Holding down R to crouch on the floating platform allows Link to safely pass under the rotating spikes across the pool.

evidence.quote: Quickly swim back to the room's entrance, and jump out to the floating platform.  Hold down the R button to make Link crouch as you pass under the rotating spikes.  On the other side of the pool, jump from the floating platform to the opposite ledge.

subject: stone block
text: Pushing the large stone block all the way to the right allows Link to jump onto it and reach the door.

evidence.quote: Kill the Big Skulltula, then move to the left side of the large stone block.  Follow Navi's instructions to push the block all the way to the right, then jump up onto the block, then jump up to the door.  Go through the door.

subject: un-lit sconces
text: Lighting the two un-lit sconces using a Deku Stick lit from the torch opens the door in the north side of the Torch Room.

evidence.quote: Kill the Deku Baba in the center of the room, then light a Deku Stick on the lit torch.  Use the flame to light the two un-lit sconces, which will open the door in the north side of the room.  Go through it.

subject: Gohma Larva
text: Gohma Larva drop from the ceiling when running in circles in the room's center, telegraph their charge attack by turning their eye red, and can be killed with single Jump Attacks.

evidence.quote: Run around in circles in the center of the room, which will provoke the Gohma Larva hanging from the ceiling to drop down.  Kill them with single Jump Attacks, but avoid their charge attack.  You know they are about to perform this when their eye turns red.

subject: Small Nest
text: Lighting a Deku Stick on the northern torches burns the webbing in the south part of the room, opening a crawl tunnel back to The Trunk.

evidence.quote: Light a Deku Stick on the torches near the north part of the room, and use the lit Deku Stick to burn the webbing in the south part of the room.  Enter the tunnel and crawl through to the other side.

subject: stone block
text: Pushing the stone block along its carved path off the cliff creates a shortcut back up to the upper level.

evidence.quote: Run to the left, and push the stone block along it's carved path and off the cliff.  Jump down, and go back to the southeast platform with the torch.  Light a Deku Stick on the torch, then jump back to the stone block.  Climb back up to the upper level

subject: floor webbing
text: Rolling over the floor webbing while holding a lit Deku Stick burns it away, opening a hole to drop to the lowest level.

evidence.quote: then run to the webbing covering the floor.  Roll over the webbing by running at it and pressing A.  The torch will make contact with the webbing as you roll, burning it away.  Drop down the new hole to the lowest level.

subject: Parasitic Armored Arachnid GOHMA
text: To stun Gohma and leave her vulnerable to sword attacks, shoot her in the eye with the Slingshot while her eye glows red.

evidence.quote: To stun Gohma and make her vulnerable to basic sword attacks, you must shoot her in the eye with the Slingshot while her eye glows red.

subject: Parasitic Armored Arachnid GOHMA
text: Shooting Gohma in the eye on the ceiling before she spawns Gohma Larva causes her to fall to the floor stunned for a long time.

evidence.quote: If you can shoot her in the eye before she is able spawn them, however, then she will fall to the floor and be stunned for a VERY long time.  You can easily get in three or four more Jump Attacks at this point, which are more then enough to shut down Gohma permanently.

subject: Parasitic Armored Arachnid GOHMA
text: Gohma leaves behind a Heart Container upon defeat.

evidence.quote: After Gohma is dead, take the Heart Container that she leaves behind, and enter the shimmering blue circle.

subject: Great Deku Tree
text: After listening to the Great Deku Tree's story outside the dungeon, he gives Link the Kokiri Emerald and asks him to seek the Princess of Destiny at Hyrule Castle.

evidence.quote: He gives Link the Kokiri Emerald, and makes one final wish: to seek out the other Spiritual Stones and prevent the "Evil Man from the Desert" (Ganondorf) from entering the Sacred Realm.  As his last piece of advice, the Deku Tree tells Link to go to Hyrule Castle and seek out the Princess of Destiny.

subject: three Deku Scrubs
text: Hit the three Deku Scrubs in the order middle first, right second, and left last to defeat them and unlock the door to the boss.

evidence.quote: If you remember the hint from Scrub Room #2, then this will be an easy puzzle.  If you forgot, or weren't paying attention, then you have to kill them in order.  The middle one is first, the one on the far right goes second, and the one on the left goes last....After the three Deku Scrubs have disappeared, the door will unlock.
